verdict.rationale: The Division offers fixed, opt-in text/email/push notices when business records change and reminders for filing deadlines. It documents no way for users to define their own rules that automatically trigger actions on events. These subscription alerts are an adjacent notification feature, not user-configurable event-driven automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can sign up to receive free electronic (text/e-mail) messages to notify you when any filings for your business are added to the State's Public Records.
